# Namib Minerals Announces Expanded Milling Plant at How Mine Operating at Full Capacity, Ahead of Schedule


October 26, 2026 9:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f9d51a07110c64e18ca73736199166ca/namibminerals/news/2026-10-26_Namib_Minerals_Announces_Expanded_Milling_Plant_109.pdf)


*Ramp-up completed well ahead of the six-to-eight-week timeline and the end-of-December target*


NEW YORK, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Namib Minerals (“Namib” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: NAMM), today announced that the expanded milling plant at How Mine has been commissioned and is now operating at its full rate of approximately 55,000 tonnes per month.


As disclosed in the Company’s first-half 2026 results on October 1, 2026, commissioning was expected in mid-October, followed by a ramp-up of approximately six to eight weeks, with the plant expected to reach its full rate by the end of December 2026.


The plant has reached that rate well ahead of this timeline. “Reaching full capacity this quickly is a credit to the How Mine team, who delivered the expansion safely and ahead of plan reflecting the teams continued operational excellence” said CEO Tulani Sikwila.


The expansion lifts How Mine’s processing capacity from approximately 40,500 tonnes per month to approximately 55,000 tonnes per month, an increase of approximately 36%. The additional capacity is expected to alleviate the milling constraint that has limited How Mine’s throughput and is expected to enable the Company to spread its existing cost base across greater production volumes. The strengthening of How Mine’s operating platform going into Q1 of 2027 allows the team to focus on maintaining plant performance which supports stronger sustainable production and cash generation.


The Company expects to provide formal 2027 production and cost guidance, including Redwing Mine’s anticipated contribution, in Q1 2027.


**About Namib Minerals**


Namib Minerals (NASDAQ: NAMM) is a gold producer, developer and explorer with operations focused in Zimbabwe. Currently Namib Minerals operates the How Mine, an underground gold mine in Zimbabwe, and aims to restart two assets in Zimbabwe. For additional information, please visit namibminerals.com.
